reviews.review_description: They even tried to get us to pay the full price 2 months before the date they scheduled to install

Had solar installed last year and worked fine, this year upgraded inverter and had battery installed spent nearly $25k in total and have had nothing but problems.Constant power flickering even when not using high power using appliances causing everything to keep shutting down, this intern is causing damage to my computer. Also once battery is charged it keeps switching to working off grid which then drops pv production so can't even run my aircon with it being charged from the meter, this is in full sun when I should be able to use free of charge.The after service is non existent  am being told only original installers can service it and they're all to busy with hew installs.Sungain take your money and don't supply any after service.

The sales pitch and paperwork processes -including extracting a healthy deposit - went well. The performance of the promise has been a complete failure. Sungain Solar was give 3 months to install then it cancelled on 4 days notice. Since then nice words of regret etc but zero action.Can’t rate the system because it is in a warehouse somewhere on the planet and not on my roof.

All aspects of dealing with supplier was extremely easy. From getting quote, explaining why certain things were included, to installation there were absolutely no problems. Customer service was admirable.

Sales/quoting process was fast and efficient whilst still providing information/details.Once signed the paperwork was done fast & efficiently and they checked that I was aware that I would be coming off the REBS scheme for the new scheme before filing the paper work. Was also contacted by their engineering department as the configuration suggested by sales (12 panels on the east roof and 18 on the west roof) had to be changed to 10 and 20 to suit the way they are connected.System installation was booked for just 2 weeks after signing up, which was incredible.Installers arrived on time and were polite and kept me informed about what was happening through out the process (including when we they needed to cut power). They also set up the inverter so that all I had to do was download the app and log-in. They were generally clean and tidy. Only hiccup was that they left the old panels (was having an older-smaller system replaced) leaning against the fence but Solargain were helpful in following up to get them collected.Overall very happy with the installation.
Thank you everyone at Sungain, great communication, installation went well, with polite and tidy staff.Would certainly recommend Sungain

I am thoroughly disappointed with the service provided by Sungain Solar. My experience has been plagued by terrible customer support and untimely responses. I had my solar system installed on April 24th, but my meter box has still not been reconfigured, months after the installation.I purchased an 11.5kW system, only to discover that my feed-in tariff (FIT) is being capped at 5kW. This effectively renders my system useless unless I purchase an additional battery. Proper technical communication and professional advice regarding this issue would have been beneficial. Had I known about these limitations, I would have opted for a Tesla Powerwall 3 battery and inverter combination from the outset.Furthermore, once the purchase was made, I had to take extensive measures, well beyond my knowledge, to configure the system correctly. This included providing necessary documents to my energy supplier, which should have been handled by Sungain Solar.Overall, my experience with Sungain Solar has been extremely frustrating, and I would not recommend their services to others.
We were glad we went with Sungain as they were easy to talk to and answered our questions Their installers were quick and very tidy

The quoting process was fast clear and very competitive, As the quote was online rather than in person the system design wasn't exactly what was delivered and the stringing of the panels isn't quite what we desired.The installation made the best of what our house offered, the team had time to answer all our questions and completed a tidy install. I would recommend Sugain Solar.

I got the system installed 30th of April and the same day it started putting out a high pitch scream at 60db on the inverter and the same noise a bit quieter at at the power metre.I contacted them and sent the proof they asked for but the manufacturer refused warranty and said it was the fan making the noise which isn't possible at the power metre on the other side of the house.Currently struggling to get them to honor the warranty and replace the inverter.Had to switch it off because I can hear it through my living room wall and it makes my ears ring.Really hope they come through and replace it with something else, I wouldn't have bought the thing if I knew it was going to make an ear piercing noise whenever it's powered up and it's been off since I got it so completely unfit for purpose.Don't get a sungrow
I had a 5KW Fronius inverter and 17 panels installed in 2022. The quoting and install process were both painless and the system has been working fine ever since.

I was introduced to Sungain Solar through Solar Quotes. Dealing with Sungain solar was an easy and transparent experience. The helped educate me on my requirements and what to expect, I didn't feel any sales pressure from them at all. They gave me options to the whims of my mind. I was particularly impressed with the installers they used, very polite and professional to deal with. They came early and pretty much got started from 7am. Midway through, they realised a plumber was needed on site to remove solar collectors, something the Solargain had neglected to organise. Sungain solar together with the installers immediately took control of the stressful situation, got a plumber in on site the same day at no extra cost. These guys are absolutely amazing. The only issue I had was after the solar installation, and obtaining the Electrical Certificate, they were supposed to follow-up with the power network and my retailer of the solar installation, but somehow the ball was dropped and that didn't happen. I followed up with Sungain Solar and It took a couple more months before I saw feed-in tarrifs on my electricity bill. I am very happy with the product and the overall result. Apart from the post installation hiccup, I would still highly recommend having your solar installed through them.

Sales process and quoting was goodInstallers were polite and tidyCustomer service not the best. There is no APP to monitor the system performance and data, I have to go via their web page to see if the unit is working or not

Sungain gave me a fair quote based on my needs. The sales representative was approachable and answered my questions in a timely manner. However, there was a slight miscommunication in our quote. We were originally told that we could get 20 panels installed with our battery but when the installation date got closer, we were informed that only 17 panels could be installed. However, this was not a huge issue as they adjusted the quote for us. The electricians who came to fit the solar panels were quite knowledgeable and did a great job. The work was clean and they explained everything well.

I have been really happy with the service we received from Sungain Solar, the sales rep who came out to quote was friendly and knowledgeable and we were happy with the quote received so decided to go ahead. Once a date was locked in everything went smoothly from the paperwork to the install and the sub contractors who installed the system were clean and tidy and helpful in setting up the monitoring app. I would happily recommend Sungain Solar to family and friends
Fantastic service from start to finish - have been recommending these guys to family and friends since the smooth install

I do not recommend using Sungain if located in Perth.The pre-sales team were at least knowledgeable and quoted a competitive deal, but it was based on multiple untruths. Firstly, they do not have an in-house team here in Perth. Instead, they use subcontractors for installation (Westlec installed our system on behalf of Sungain) and only have a sales team based out of a few desks in a rented office in Osborne Park. Secondly, the time frame quoted was 4 weeks. In the end, we waited 7.5 weeks, and even then, that was only because we really pushed for it and threatened to cancel. Thirdly, we were pushed to sign the contract before a site visit could be arranged. This goes against the advice of the Solar Quote website and should have been a red flag for us, but unfortunately, we were too focused on the low price and quick timeframes offered.Post-sale, communication was diabolical. It was apparent they were very reluctant to visit the site pre-installation, leaving it until the week before and again, only after I repeatedly pressed for it. The first proposed site visit was also cancelled with no notice as well, which was very inconvenient and frustrating because I worked from home that specific day and moved meetings etc around to accommodate it.The post-sale team is based on the East Coast. Communication regarding time, financing arrangements etc was very, very poor. There was an annoying habit of ignoring emails all week, only to then respond shortly before 5pm East Coast time on a Friday with minimal/ no update. Of course, by then, the office was closed and there was no opportunity to engage, so it would inevitably roll into another week.Install was also sub-standard. The Fronius inverter we were provided with turns out to be not the most up to date model. This was not mentioned or discussed during the sales process. The installation team left lots of rubbish, nails and bits of packaging dotted around our property. We also asked if any roof tiles were damaged during installation and were gleefully told "no", only to find out a few weeks later that 2 tiles had been cracked and one dislodged and chipped via another electrician we had visit for another matter.Post-installation communication has also been very poor and again, all East Coast based. We were underwhelmed by the performance of our system, which seemed to be massively underperforming. We drew this to Sungain's attention. We were told a variety of reasons as to why this was the case and why a visit to inspect would not be required. First it was a Fronius software update. Then we were told it was a shading issue (despite Sungain being responsible for the location of the panels and the trees etc being well known to them at the time of installation). Finally, they asked if it was perhaps a switchboard issue at our end. In fact, the real reason as we eventually found out after 3-4 weeks of back and forth, was because our system was capped here due to WA grid regulations, and therefore wasn't exporting back to the grid as per East Coast systems. Local knowledge would have identified this issue straight away. Similarly, it would have been good to have been informed this pre-installation, in which case we wouldn't have gone for such a large system if we knew it would only be capped at usage.We also received a random email two weeks ago seeking to address the above issue (about 9 weeks after we asked it). It seems there was no internal communication at Sungain and nobody had marked the issue as resolved.Finally, I write this review as I have been asked to do it by Sungain. They have financially incentivised me to do so. $30 per review, up to a value of $90. Please therefore be wary of short, positive reviews.We have gone with a different company for our battery installation. We recommend other WA-based customers do the same, and don't get lured in by Sungain's competitive pricing.
Customer service and installation was all great, very effective no problems

The team at Sungain Solar were great to deal with. They were patient and understanding when going through the costs and the maths when we had questions. Now a year on we are super happy with our panels!

During the quote process they were quick, open and honest.  While it didn't end up being the cheapest quote , their communication gave me confidence.  Installation was brought forward and the install team were great.  I’ve had a couple of enquiries since installation and they are happy to respond and help.  The overall product is very good and I am very happy I went through Sungain

When I first contacted Sungain solar I got a lady in Queensland she was absolutely fantastic quick efficient and very knowledgeable.The service from the Osborne Park team was equally as good promotional and helpful.I had a problem with the WiFi I sent an email and they resolved the issue straight away.Excellent service

Don't choose Sungain Solar in Perth unless you're prepared for delays and disappointment.Victoria based with no installation team or capability here in Perth.Demanded 30 percent deposit that was reluctantly paid end of Feb because they were the cheapest of my 3 quote referrals via Solar Quotes website.Drop the ball for 2 months after being told "4 weeks and it will be on your roof".Countless chasing and following up at my end while thinking I may have been scammed due to genetic email responses. Also had a 6am call from someone wanting to schedule an installation inspection the same day because the weather in Australia was changing (weather was fine that week).Requested me to fund additional costs for scaffolding after a 3rd party installer inspection (that took 2 attempts because the inspector only had a short ladder and had to return a few days later with a second short ladder to reach the roof) late April.I pushed back on the additional cost because the agreed price included my 2 storey installation.Senior rep called to apologise for the unacceptable performance of his team blaming a single underperforming staff member.Senior rep attempted to engage another 3rd party installer to do a "drive by site inspection" but was unable to provide a date or timeframe for installation.I suggested a full refund would be the best course of action to relieve pressure off all parties.Received refund minus "stripe charges" within 2 working days.Skilled at providing timely refunds (minus $22) but not much else.

We decided to go with Sungain Solar based on a positive recommendation from friends who were happy with their own solar upgrade from Sungain.Josh, our contact at Sungain, was knowledgeable and straightforward about costs and timelines. He took the time to go through the details, ensuring the solar setup was a good fit for our property and energy needs. It was refreshing to deal with someone so upfront in an industry where transparency isn't always the norm.Sungain's warranties on the panels and inverter seemed competitive, and their experience in the field gave us confidence that any issues down the line would be handled well.The installation went smoothly and was completed in a day. They paid attention to detail, adjusting the panel placement to look good on our roof. Communication was clear, and they accommodated our preferences for the inverter placement.Overall, our experience with Sungain Solar was positive, and we'd consider using them again in the future. Thanks to Josh and the team for their professionalism. Cheers again, Dan
The team were very easy to deal with, answered my questions and followed through with a professional fit-out for our home. Very happy and would recommend others consider Sungain

The team at Sungain Solar were really great, and offered us a range of options for our property in Narrogin. They were one of the few installers that were happy to go out to a rural area, and the additional price for doing so was minimal. The installation team was also professional and courteous when they came out and did a solid job of the install. We’ve had it running for nearly 6 months now and it hasn’t had any issues at all.

I am absolutely thrilled with my new 10kW 3 phase system from Sungain Solar. The upgrade from my previous 6.6kW system has resulted in significant savings for me, amounting to thousands of dollars per year. Throughout the entire process, Paul from Sungain Solar was incredibly patient and accommodating. He worked with me for weeks, updating the quote multiple times until it was exactly what I wanted. Once we agreed on the system upgrade, the installation was promptly scheduled.I've already recommended Sungain Solar to a friend who also had a fantastic experience. Compared to other companies, he was amazed at how quickly Sungain Solar locked in an installation date at a fair price, after struggling for weeks with other providers.I would definitely recommend Sungain Solar to anyone looking to install a solar system in their home.

We are very happy with Sungain,the whole process from quoting to installation was so easy, they aldo connected us to the grid.Customer service was great, good communication skills.Staff very polite, and helpful explaining the system.
Was organised quickly,  we had an issue with one aspect which was so quickly replaced and haven't had an issue since
A system just got installed on my mum and dad’s place and it’s awesome no more complaining about leaving the lights on
Sales is knowlegable and quick and happy to check and amend to ciustomer needs.Instalaltion day went smooth and tidy.Customer service is good and responsive when having issue.

Super happy with our SolarSungain were Fantastic and took the time to explain all the options to us and even recommended that we don’t get a battery as the financial benefit wasn’t there yet and suggested we wait for them to become more cost effective. The installation was smooth and efficient. Really happy with our system

I would highly recommend Sungain Solar .From the quote to the entire installation everything ran smoothly.The installers were punctual, polite and left the premises tidy when they finished.I was more than happy with their quote. The system has been excellent,our electricity bills minimal.Thanks guys for an excellent job.
Solar quotes really knocked it out the park.Competitive quote good sales experience and great installers. Would definately recommend them and i would happily use them again.

Sungain Solar from Melbourne were really good to deal with. Excellent knowledge about their product and what looks to be a good support package. They certainly weren't the cheapest but happy to pay for quality and service. Their installers were very efficient, very tidy, and very friendly with good communication. I would not hesitate to engage or recommend these guys to anyone looking to install a solar system. What else can I say - very happy with the solution and their work.

I wanted to bring to your attention my recent experience with the installation process after signing up for your services.Initially, I was pleased with the front end of the process; the design and quoting stages were handled well, with questions promptly answered and quotes adjusted accordingly. However, difficulties arose post sign-up. Approvals were significantly delayed due to administrative issues, leading to a lack of communication and leaving me in the dark about the progress. This lack of transparency made me question the legitimacy of the business, causing significant frustration on my end.Despite these challenges, approval eventually came through, and installation dates were secured. Unfortunately, the installation itself did not go smoothly. An unexpected supplier logistics delay caused a postponement, leading to rescheduling and rearranging of priorities on my part. To add to the frustration, there was no proper handover post-installation, and I had to actively chase down the subcontractor for basic login information.The most disappointing part of this experience has been the ongoing lack of communication post-installation. Despite numerous attempts to contact Sungain Solar for essential information regarding consumption and net usage, I have not received any meaningful responses or support. This disregard for customer service is truly disheartening, especially considering the initial faith I had in your company when signing up for your services.I urge you to address these communication gaps and improve the customer service experience for future clients. Clear and timely communication is crucial in ensuring customer satisfaction and trust in your services.

I chose Sungain Solar for my solar system installation in Perth. Initially, the representative provided a satisfactory quote and assured a 2 to 3-week installation timeframe. However, after making the down payment, I was informed of a 6-week wait, contrary to the initial promise. Despite this, I arranged my schedule for the confirmed installation date of April 12th, which was just beyond the 6-week period. I settled the full invoice before the installation date as requested. Unfortunately, the installation team did not turn up as scheduled on the installation day, and I received no communication regarding the cancellation. Subsequent attempts to contact Sungain Solar for rescheduling have been met with unresponsiveness, leaving me without any installation date and awaiting a callback that has yet to come.This experience has been highly disappointing and reflects poorly on Sungain Solar's professionalism. I can't recommend a company that fails to uphold basic customer service standards.

Sugain Solar installed a 6.6kW Jinko solar system with a GoodWe inverter for us, and it's been fantastic. Luke Peterson and Jules Lowrie were great to deal with—super informative and not pushy at all. They helped us from start to finish, even coordinating with our retailer. The system works great, and we're really happy with the service from Sugain Solar!

I had decided to purchase a Fronius system specifically to connect to my Home Assistant smart home, the salesperson was impressed that I had done my research and that I was an easy customer who needed no sales pitch. I was told if I ordered quickly, I could get a more premium all-black install at the price of a regular install (as part of a bulk order for a commercial customer), and that it should be on our roof in 3-4 weeks. We proceeded with the contract.As soon as we paid the deposit, our friendly salesperson vanished and every time I have called their office since, I have spoken to a different "Virtual Receptionist" who doesn't work for Sungain but only takes messages. After waiting several weeks with no updates about approval, I contacted Sungain, who replied the next day and said that our install was approved, but that now their installers might be busy for up to 8 weeks (delay tactic?). After pushing back, we did end up with an install date sooner. Their engineer then contacted me and told me that the proposal I had selected on Solarquotes was now not possible, and my system would be a different configuration with slightly less performance.On the day of the install, I was told that the panel configuration would be changed again, to a simpler install. The subcontractor and assistant started early and were finished in 3 hours. The "premium all black finish" that we were supposed to have delivered, now has small scratches and marks on all of the corners where they lifted the panels on the driveway. Putting the cardboard box down first would have protected the finish, a minor detail but showing a lack of care/professionalism. The installers were the least-worst part of my experience. The salesperson I spoke to told me we would have an all-black finish, however the frame holding the panels is regular untreated aluminium. Again, it won't affect the solar performance, but it is NOT what we agreed upon. I should get the product that I was quoted, not a cheaper and simpler product.Unfortunately my experience with Sungain got a lot worse after installation. The subcontractor told me Sungain would finish setting up my inverter including registering with the manufacturer for cloud/app monitoring, and crucially, the Inverter Customer Password that I need to access the Smart Home features of the inverter that were a KEY purchasing requirement. Sungain has never returned ANY of my calls and emails, in the end I waited an hour on hold with Fronius to reset the password myself. (Side note: my integration with Home Assistant now works brilliantly, after enabling it myself)My system has an export limit set when there shouldn't be, meaning I am only operating at half performance. And finally, I have asked Sungain to provide me with an updated Solarquotes "proposal" with the system that they have installed, so that I can compare what they initially advertised versus what they delivered. They have not replied.Sungain had below average customer service before installation, the installation was not the quality I expected, the product we got delivered was not what we paid for, and Sungain has not provided ANY customer service whatsoever since install. I have tried ringing their head office, emailing the people I spoke to directly, and emailing the general inbox and have never had my messages returned. I suppose my only other option to reach someone there is to go in person.Given their zero customer service this close to purchase, I expect that if I have any major faults with my system, I will have to once again do all the legwork to have the issue fixed, their advertised "17 year warranty" is completely worthless if you can't get in contact with anyone at the company. I would not recommend Sungain for any reason.

Upon searching for the best solar company, we came across Sungain Solar, extremely professional prompt and fitted the main solar box and all the panels shortly after. We were shown how to use the app and checked in on us to make sure we were happy. Great experience and would highly recommend this company for your next solar investment.
From quoting to commissioning of our solar system, we found sungain solar to be very efflicient and professional

Sungain was one of the 3 companies put forward to us via SolarQuotes and was the best value from the quotes we received for a 6.6kW system.From accepting the quote, it only took 2-3 weeks before the installation was carried out last June by the team which took 3-4 hours.Since then, we have enjoyed greatly reduced electricity bills and even had nothing to pay during some periods.

I was looking for a while to get Solar system on my roof as Energy bill are going out of control, luckily I clicked on Sunsolarquotes and Sungain solar come up as the most reasonable in price and  good reviews .I decided to give a go and called them, in no time I found out they are what I was looking for! .They been good since and I do recommend them , In my opinion they are NOT like other companies, ( full of ),  they are exactly what it says on the tin.
Everything went well, sales service team excellent.
Very good customer service, lots of information provided before agreeing to sale. Great installation, very tidy.
Great service from start to finish. Power bills have been reduced by half.

About end of September 2023 paid deposit for the system and batterys, installation x 2 visits now have panels on roof and wiring runs awaiting connection, awaiting other parts to be connected and when they can visit again, installers great efficient but logistics I suspect are an issue re regional installation. We are trying to be patient.Had a business system installed in my business premises, x 3 months start to finish in our town. Company base in same Melbourne arealooking forward to finalising our part installation. We wonder when it will all be joined together and working.
The team , worked well together,everyone had there job to do, and the apprentice work with the tradie.i was surprised to see they were actually teaching the young people .and they were on time.

We got several quotes when looking for solar installation, Sungain solar were not our first choice as we ended up accepting a quote with of the cheaper options with sun boost and paying a deposit.When another tradesman come to our house they told us that we couldnt have the system we wanted and that we would have to get less panels and put them sideways which we accepted only for them to reject our job a week later upon second visit because they didn’t realise we had a tile roof and the spacing in our roof trusses wouldn’t work for their panels apparently.We rang sungain back and explained the issues that we went through ,they had a tradesman out to our house with in the week and we got the extra panels we originally wanted and for a great priceCheers

Organising installation was seamless. Good value for money and saving money on power since installation. Highly recommend this company given how easy everything was from the day of receiving quote until day of installation. Performance has been great and is great being able to track electricity usage and receding electricity rebates for unused power. Haven’t had any issues since installation, so far so good

Signed up with sungainsolar on January 24 and received an installation date of 20th of February. The morning of the installationn, I received a SMS saying that the installation wouldn't be going ahead because of a stick team member. A week went by with no contact from anyone. Numerous phone calls to a receptionist, another few days went by until the receptionist herself ended up just saying that they could fit them in April but no exact date. Absolute muck around!!! I requested a refund and that was another muck around for a week. Stay away from this company!!!!!!

From the start the team at Sungain were professional, helpful and friendly offering a competitive system.The install was done on the prescribed day and the system has been operating efficiently since day one.Highly recommended!

The sales and quoting process with Sungain Solar was straightforward and transparent. They provided detailed information about the system options available and helped me choose the best fit for my home and budget. The installation process was impressive – the team was not only polite and punctual but also exceptionally tidy, ensuring minimal disruption to my daily routine. Their customer service was exceptional, going above and beyond to assist with organizing the grid connection after the install. They handled all the necessary paperwork and coordination seamlessly, making the entire experience hassle-free. Overall, very happy with Sungain Solar
Easy to deal with great after service and my system has worked above and beyond what I expected

We were very happy with the advice, communication and service by Sungain. We had a few issues with the Inverter software and Klaudia was excellent in assisting us to get it sorted. I would definately recommend Sungain Solar.

My partner and I had a 6kw solar system installed through sungain back in august 2023, and we couldn’t be happier with how the whole process went right from the getting the quotes to the installation process. The company was very thorough with their products and systems that they used and the benefits we would get from having solar. Since installation we haven’t had any issues and the follow up care post installation has been brilliant. Great all round service and product quality, highly recommended!

From the initial consultation right through to the installation of our solar system, sungain have been fantastic! The sales representative Annie wasn’t pushy and was super accomodating with our financial requests when it came to payment. We had a system installed and we couldn’t be happy with it, and was good value and quality! We couldn’t recommend them enough!
Sungain were responsive & helpful; they managed to arrange installation within a very quick timeframe. Would definitely recommend.
Luke from Sungain was very knowledgeable and gave me a competitive priced
Nice service, good price, quality product. So far working very well. Saved a lot of money for electricity.

Wasn't sure what model would  be suitable for my needs IRT energy efficiency, Luke was very helpful with explaining the different options.Customer service couldn't be better, there was a delay with installing the solar but they were very helpful with any issues that arised.Getting solar was the best thing I could do. Saved a lot of moneyThanks again Luke!
Great service informative great prices speedy service highly recommended they know their stuff

This was our first venture into solar and I had many questions of the Sungain sales person at the initial consultation and afterwards. At no time did I sense that I was being pushed to make a decision or that I was being a pain. The system is not the cheapest nor the most expensive, but represented what I considered to be the best value for money.All the relevant approvals etc were taken care of so the whole process was easy.Apart from a few challenges getting connected to the inverter via the app, the system has been faultless since installation and delivers the output expected when I have a load such as the AC to fully utilise the generated power.Would love to have a battery to capture the generated power rather than it go unused but batteries just don't make economic sense to me yet.Will gladly use Sungain for any subsequent solar power requirements.

Sales team were very helpful, provided several different options and explained pros/cons of each, then went and found a slightly different model of inverter & smart meter that provided extra features I was looking for.The Install was scheduled very quickly, the installers arrived on time, got everything installed cleanly. There was one configuration issue with the smart meter, they were back within a couple of hours and had it working perfectly.They took care of all of the provider paperwork and meter upgrade.Extremely smooth experience throughout. The system has been running for about 18mo now without issue.

It's been a year since we installed Sungain Solar. Their quote was very reasonable and the customer service from initiating contract was very professional.Their installers were very professional - arrived on time, checked details with us in respect of panel locations and installed the 6.6kW system in a timely manner. The pricing was very reasonable.Full instructions about the system and the inverter were also given at the end, including assistance with connecting the smart monitoring via the Fronius app.We have no hesitation in recommending Sungain Solar.

I had my solar panels installed about 12 months ago with sungain. They were one of 3 companies that were sent to me via solar quotes. They were mid range for pricing but I felt comfortable with the staff and their knowledge of the products. Even after I signed the contract and paid the deposit they offered me a a new style or brand of panel or inverter  that was actually cheaper than the original quote. They kept me updated on the progress. It all happened with very little effort from me.

We have a 13.3kw system installed by Sungain in 2022. Quote was prompt, online and clear. Excellent customer service, informed us of the process from begin till end. Some startup issues have been dealt with promptly. AusNet was a bit slow with the whole process which is not Sungain fault. Pleasure to deal with. Haven't paid next to nothing for electricity from the grid since! Happy customer...

The whole process started off ok, with the sales person being quite helpful, albeit quite pushy and pressuring me to place an order straight away once the quote was received. I placed an order and paid a deposit on 24 October 2023 for a 10Kw solar system, 10 Kw battery and heat pump HWS and was told installation should be completed before the end of December. On checking just before Christmas I was told the lead time was now 6-8 weeks and that the Xmas/NY break added another 3 to 4 weeks to that time frame. My installation was only just completed last Wednesday 6 March 2024.My SolarVic government rebate approvals also had to be extended as they were due to expire which would mean re-applying all over again. I had a phone call on 27/2/24 stating the installation would commence the next day. Short notice I thought, but was happy to at least get things started. However on double checking that the install included solar panels, battery and HWS I was told that the company was having trouble sourcing the HWS and that would be done at a later date. As the installation of the solar panels necessitated the removal of our existing solar HWS from the roof I told the caller that everything needed to be installed at the same time otherwise we would be without hot water until the new HWS was received and installed. He seemed surprised at this and said he would check again with the supplier. Another phone call 4 hours later informed me they had sourced a HWS and would be starting installation on 4 March 2024.  The installation process took 3 days with 3 electricians not arriving until 11am each day. An apprentice put his foot through our ceiling while in the roof space which will cost over $1,700 to repair. (this amount was deducted from our payment to Sungain) The installers also cut through the roof sarking during installation and when I queried why this happened I was told that was the only way to do it and that the sarking would be repaired before the colourbond roof panel was replaced. On checking this the next day the sarking had NOT been repaired and the roof panel had been replaced. The sarking was eventually repaired. The HWS was EXTREMELY heavy and had apparently been loaded onto the installers truck with a forklift (it was on a pallet) However NO thought was given as to how it would be unloaded with no lifting equipment available at our address. > How was the sales/quoting process?Sungain have issues with communication - many emails were either replied to late or not at all. They claimed they had a staff member leave at short notice but that doesn't change the experience I had during the install.The quote used an out of date aerial. The house is completely different now (single story demolish and two story rebuild). I wanted an idea of where the panels would be laid so I had an idea of what it would look like and so I knew the installers wouldn't just wing it on the day. We also have a higher than standard roof pitch and I wanted to ensure that the installers would be aware of this to avoid wasting my time.• Getting Sungain to update this took multiple emails and phone calls across two weeks.• I also proposed a site survey prior to install - this was knocked back.• Post install I requested the model and brand of the frame used to mount the panels. I had to ask three times before getting a response.> How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?The installers arrived on time but with plans containing a panel layout that did not match the one on the quote (west facing not north facing). I asked them to try and install it like the plans I had been sent if possible but to let me know what was possible before starting.They were also not aware it was a two story house and did not come with enough people and had inappropriate safety gear. During the install metal framing was dropped off the roof, along with a drill.There was damage to our property during the install:• The installers scratched our brand new shed door (less than 24 hours after it had been built).• They put a hole in our flyscreen.They did not admit to these on the day but did once I called and questioned it.How these things were handled after being raised:• The installers replaced the flyscreen but incorrectly re-mounted the sliding door. Given the issues with the flyscreen door I think I prefer this.> Post installSungain handle all the registration of your SMA inverter with SMA themselves, including creating an account for you. This sounds convenient but I prefer to do these things myself as I like to have control over my privacy settings.a) Used the email address I contacted them on, which is not the one I use to register for accountb) Enabled sharing my data publicly in Sunny Places which shares my Address as well as my First Name and Last Name with any other users on Sunny PlacesThey apologised for enabling the data sharing and said they would ensure it doesn't happen for other customers but I would prefer they don't create accounts on behalf of their customers.
